optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Pipeline Engineer, Developer Tools Platform

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the build-event ingestion pipelines and their schemas.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the build-event ingestion pipelines (Kafka consumers writing to the events warehouse) and their schemas, adding schema versioning so that older event formats kept loading after producer changes.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the daily aggregate jobs that feed the engineering dashboards.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the daily aggregate jobs that roll build, test and deployment events into the per-repository tables behind the engineering dashboards.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Cut the daily aggregate's completion time, reported against the platform's published pipeline baseline.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: The daily aggregate's completion time dropped from 3 hours 40 minutes to 1 hour 10 minutes after the incremental rewrite was released, measured over the following thirty days in the pipeline monitoring dashboard against the published baseline of 3 hours 40 minutes.

skills.text: Coordinates schema and job changes with the dashboard and platform teams and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated schema and job changes with the dashboard team and the platform team in the weekly data sync; the platform lead approved warehouse changes and the dashboard team confirmed the table contracts.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with maintaining build-event ingestion pipelines, daily aggregate jobs, and cutting the daily aggregate's completion time. They do not establish the candidate's documentation of lineage, known limitations, and hand-over conditions for each pipeline release.
